code_pass.measured: 39 named refusal classes across 13 of 23 chartered components (floor grep on class names; an UNDERCOUNT — ruling's gate refuses via bare ValueError and is invisible to the class census, so doors-in-fact > doors-by-name). Zero components import the primitive (grep declare_contract|from cairn.learning_block outside learning_block/: empty).
code_pass.reading: The DOOR organ is already Cairn's native idiom — refusal-with-named-lacks is everywhere. What NO door has is the back four organs: no TRACE (a refusal vanishes after firing — no denominator anywhere), no FINDING at exit, no VERDICT capture when a human overrides or judges, no DIAL. Deployment is therefore a RETROFIT of the back four onto existing doors, almost never a new door.
code_pass.cheapest_universal_move: wire existing doors' firings — green AND red — into lb.write_trace with a declared consumer. One wire per door buys the denominator systemwide and makes the dial read across the whole system; the refusal corpus becomes training data the day the wire lands. This is deliberately smaller than full migration (contract + finding + gate), which rides the touch rule below.

ticket_pass.measured: 70 tickets: 38 PROVED, 10 BUILDME, 4 PROVEME (web-server, logger-for-bash, superclaude-starts-itself, intentions-model-compiler), 10 TICKETME, 5 THINKME, 1 stale LEARNME cursor (the-deposit-rides-the-read — a summons retired 2026-07-30 still standing on a ticket; small, real, filed here so it's loud).
ticket_pass.reading: By the touch rule, the first component migrations ride the in-flight voyages when they resume: the four at PROVEME are touched next, so they get asked first. The skill roster is NOT in this lane — it is a closed small-N set and goes one-blow per the standing ticket (skills-migrate-one-blow).

the_loop_read.claim: Two nested loops generalize every learning structure in the system, and both already exist in more than one dress.
the_loop_read.inner: the CONFORM loop, per firing: refuse with every lack named -> sender conforms -> re-fire. Already physics at every door; the primitive's contribution is that the trace COUNTS the iterations (send_backs), so the loop's cost is measurable.
the_loop_read.outer: the TENURE loop, per gate: verdicts accumulate -> an inspector learns to predict the gate owner -> match_rate crosses the owner's threshold -> the gate DELEGATES DOWN A STRATUM (Akien -> inspector+Hex -> tree -> code floor). The chart bricks' floor/tree/ceiling boundary-moving-down, the librarian's tenure-loop design, and the primitive's dial are the SAME loop in three dresses — it can be named once, hosted by the primitive as a generic reading of the dial.
the_loop_read.power: because the exit condition is a MEASURED gate (not a vibe), blocks nest: a question nexus is a TREE of learning blocks where each parent's door is fed by its children's dials. That is the Shakespeare/cancer flash as mechanism — a correctly built nexus converges on the limits of what is known, and its power scales with what the gates can measure, not with the loop machinery. The loop machinery is finished; the frontier is always instrumentation.

the_scope_rule_named: Akien's three migration decisions imply one rule, recorded so it stops being re-derived: a CLOSED small-N set migrates ONE-BLOW (skills, N=9 — his challenge-pass overrule); an OPEN or large set migrates ON-TOUCH (components — his rule this pass; logging call sites — 'migrate as we go, rather than all at once'). The touch-time question 'is this component a learning block yet?' is floor-checkable (does it declare a contract) and berths as a /sail entry step, physics not memory, when the migration campaign builds it.
